themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Breaking-news or story push notifications, including the lack of an in-app way to disable them, their frequency, and notifications that stay in the tray after being opened.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Creating, saving, reordering, finding and clearing the playlist or queue, including playlists that get deleted on closing the app or after updates.

themes.name: Live station streaming
themes.description: Connecting to and playing live radio and local station streams, including stations that never connect, are missing, or show 'no audio available' or 'connecting' forever.

themes.name: Buffering and dropouts
themes.description: Audio that buffers, stutters or cuts out during playback, including drops when switching between WiFi and mobile data or when interrupted by phone calls and alerts.

themes.name: Skipping and story cut-offs
themes.description: Audio that skips forward or backward, restarts, starts mid-story, or ends before the story finishes, particularly within playlists and podcasts.

themes.name: Crashes and freezes
themes.description: App crashes, force closes, freezes, lock-screen conflicts and other general instability or bugs.

themes.name: Battery and background activity
themes.description: Battery drain, memory use, and the app running or restarting in the background, including the lack of a way to close or exit it.

themes.name: Ads
themes.description: Banner ads and pop-up ads in the app, including ads that cannot be closed, block screen space or text, or precede audio.

themes.name: Chromecast support
themes.description: Requests for or comments about casting audio to Chromecast or other cast devices and external playback.

themes.name: Offline downloads
themes.description: Ability or inability to download articles, podcasts or programs for offline listening or reading.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: Visual look, layout, outdated UI, material design, dark theme and ease of navigating the app, including needing to tap 'load more stories'.

themes.name: Tablet and screen rotation
themes.description: Support for landscape mode, auto-rotation and tablet-sized layouts.

themes.name: Political bias and fairness
themes.description: Opinions on NPR's editorial slant, objectivity, trustworthiness and political leaning, such as liberal bias or praise for unbiased reporting.

themes.name: News content quality
themes.description: Opinions on the quality, depth, variety and informative value of NPR's stories, programs and reporting itself, apart from bias.

themes.name: Loading and connection errors
themes.description: Content that fails to load or shows 'check connection' or 'unable to play media' errors despite a working connection, and slow load times for stories, audio or the app.

themes.name: Permissions and privacy
themes.description: Concerns about location, contacts or phone-call access and other personal data the app requests or collects.

themes.name: Images and article display
themes.description: Problems displaying or reading article content, such as missing photos, tweets or videos, overlapping text, small font size or scrolling glitches.

themes.name: Hourly news
themes.description: The hourly newscast feature, including it not playing, replaying old headlines, or only playing the sponsor message.

themes.name: Update regressions
themes.description: Comments on how the app has changed over app versions, including features lost or broken, improvements, or lack of updates and developer support.
